perks.name: Taking Initiative
perks.description: Hitting combatants with melee attacks or Sword strikes grants a stack of Initiative, giving bonus handling and reload. Stacks decay slowly over time.
perks.exact:
Upon scoring a Melee, Glaive Melee, or Sword Damage Instance:
Grants a stack of Initiative for 8 seconds, up to a maximum of 5 stacks.
Initiative grants +Handling and +Reload Speed.
Stacks decay one at a time.
Can stack on Immune Enemies and with DoT as well, such as Sword Storm Combo, Smoke Bomb, and Scorch Ticks.

perks.name: Healing Initiative
perks.description: While you have Initiative, using your class ability creates a stationary healing aura. The aura gains increased healing based on the number of Initiative stacks.
perks.exact:
On Class Ability Usage while Initiative is active:
Creates a stationary Healing Drone that restores HP every 2 seconds in a 7 meter radius. Instantly releases the first pulse on usage.
Healing Drone restores 10 HP per Initiative stack per pulse up to 5 times per Class Ability Usage.
Healing Drone has no collision but can block projectiles.
